title: Change default behavior for Choice when no otherwise Processor is set
description: In a mule flow, when using a <choice> message router without setting a Processor in the <otherwise> section, and the MuleMessage does not match any of the <when> clauses, an exception is thrown. To achieve a conditional behavior currently mule requires to set a dummy processor on the otherwise clause. One usability improvement would be letting the message be processed by the remaining part of the flow if no <when> clause was matched and no <otherwise> processor provided.
clean_text: Change default behavior for Choice when no otherwise Processor is set. In a mule flow, when using a message router without setting a Processor in the section, and the MuleMessage does not match any of the clauses, an exception is thrown. To achieve a conditional behavior currently mule requires to set a dummy processor on the otherwise clause. One usability improvement would be letting the message be processed by the remaining part of the flow if no clause was matched and no processor provided.

title: until-successful should support synchronous use cases
description: Imagine a simple synchronous HTTP proxy use case, e.g.:    <flow>      <http:inbound-endpoint.../>      <http:outbound-endpoint.../>  </flow>    If outbound endpoint is wrapped in until-successful, the flow won't work anymore. until-successful must support synchronous scenarios as well.
